product_metadata.title: Holmes HBF2001DP-BM 20-Inch Box Fan,Black
features: 20-inch box fan ideal for medium and large rooms
Sturdy design with attachable feet for added stability
description: Keep medium and large rooms cool during hot, humid summer months with the Holmes Box Fan. This 20-inch circulating fan features a wide coverage area for expansive cooling relief and three speed settings for optimal airflow and comfort. A removable grill makes cleaning easy, while integrated cord storage allows the fan to be stored compactly. The sturdy metal frame and attachable feet keep the fan stable while in use, making it a great choice for living rooms, kitchens, and bedrooms. This box fan has a 20-inch blade span and measures approximately 4.5 by 21 by 21 inches.
